description.zh:
返回结果显示的语言。取值：

- zh-CN：中文

- en-US：英文
description.en:
The language of the returned results. Valid values:

- zh-CN: Chinese

- en-US: English

description.zh: 地址的ID，地址唯一标识码。
description.en: The ID of the address. This ID uniquely identifies the address.

description.zh: 用户生成的请求token。用于保证请求的幂等性。该参数值可自定义，但是要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符。
description.en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can specify a custom value for this parameter, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.

description.zh:
地址启用状态：
- enable：启用，当前地址健康检查正常的情况下可参与解析。
- disable： 禁用，当前地址不管健康检查是否正常，均不可参与解析。
description.en:
The enabling state of the address. Valid values:

*   enable: The address is enabled and the address can be used for Domain Name System (DNS) resolution if the address passes health checks.
*   disable: The address is disabled and the address cannot be used for DNS resolution regardless of whether the address passes health checks or not.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun alidns update-cloud-gtm-address-enable-status --accept-language en-US --client-token 1ae05db4-10e7-11ef-b126-00163e240000 --address-id addr-895182181143680000 --enable-status enable --region cn-hangzhou
